report:
Fresh review of crates.sage_ir.types.spans.offset_reuse after the associated attribute-origin correction. I inspected the current complete claim, five ordinary implementation entries and their source files, both ordinary test bodies and the explicit TODO test. I restarted after the parser editor reported stable source and inspected the resulting parser diff; all other initial fragments and association sets remained unchanged within this review. This assessment is based on current evidence, not the previous verdict.

Requirements and scope: an outside edit that only changes an item's absolute placement must leave its relative CST and typed contents equal and must not invalidate semantic consumers that did not read that coordinate. Diagnostics and position lookups may change. Edits altering item content, bindings or other semantic dependencies are outside this premise.

Implementation accounting: span.rs stores relative offsets separately from AbsoluteSpan and derives equality/update for them; AbsoluteSpan::resolve composes an origin with an unchanged relative range. parse/util.rs subtracts the item base and obtains the first attribute/item start. parse/items.rs supplies that base to CST construction and computes absolute placement separately. The corrected associated-item parser retains pending attributes until after parsing, measures child_start from the first attribute, changes only the parent-relative placement.start, and passes child_start into function/type/const CST parsing. Those helpers set the full item range to 0..(end-child_start) and parse attributes at the same base. The captured attribute helper likewise subtracts item_start, so translating the complete attributed item preserves these offsets. associated.rs selects definitions by kind/name/occurrence, copies the selected CST into a fresh item stash, resolves placement separately, and constructs the same name/scope/owner identity. fns.rs stores cst and span as separate tracked fields. Its signature/body queries read the former and semantic dependencies rather than self.span; body node construction and diagnostics consume relative CST spans. These boundaries permit coordinate observations to update without making a coordinate-independent semantic consumer depend on placement.

Test accounting: moving_associated_item_reuses_method_signature_and_body covers both trait and impl contexts. It forces the target body and checks empty diagnostics, checks a repeated warm request executes no queries, inserts a distinct preceding sibling, forces the body again, then asserts the complete sorted execution trace. The allowed trace includes owner signature/items and associated identity reconstruction, but no target function signature/body execution. Captured Database helpers show the log records WillExecute and is drained between observations, making this an actual reuse assertion. A placement leak into target CST or an absolute-coordinate dependency in those target queries would introduce executions and fail the snapshot. moving_source_item_preserves_derive_expansion_identity prepends a newline outside a derived struct, then compares the actual generated source ID and its origin start: identity stays equal and origin changes. It exercises allowed coordinate change but does not assert generated CST/typed equality or consumer reuse. Captured setup_root_module parses the edited file into current tracked symbols; the builtin fixture supplies Clone resolution.

The sole TODO, types_spans_offset_reuse, explicitly defers extending plain/generated insertion/removal edits to compare resolved positions, semantic values and downstream reuse. Its prerequisite is those additional observations and scenarios in the edit fixtures. This remains an honest test-coverage deferral: explicit relative CST/typed-value comparisons, removal coverage and full generated semantic reuse are not supplied by the two ordinary tests. The empty TODO body is not credited as a verification, and the derive identity assertion is not inflated into a full semantic result. Existing ordinary evidence is substantive partial coverage and the explicit TODO accounts for the remaining matrix. There are no N/A entries and no implementation behavior has been relabeled as deferred.

Execution: this refresh ran review start/read and source-inspection commands only; no behavioral tests or builds were executed by this reviewer in this refresh. Root centrally runs relevant suites per the captured instructions. I made no source changes. No additional edits are requested; acceptance retains the visible testing TODO and does not claim exhaustive tested behavior.
